_comment: Machine-readable format descriptor for the packed QR payload (spec #24, sub-issue #26). Single source of truth: tools/gen_format_descriptor.py renders this into a C header consumed identically by the ROM pack adapter (src/pipeline/pack_adapter.c) and the host unpack adapter (tools/pipeline_test), so the two can never disagree on the wire layout. Field contents here are the sub-issue #26 minimal/stubbed shape proving the wiring; the full payload contents (serialize/sign/pack, #28/#29) land in later sub-issues.
